# Notexia

> Notexia (https://notexia.in) is an all-in-one AI-powered study platform, notes repository, and academic collaboration network built for Indian students, engineering undergraduates, and competitive exam aspirants (JEE, NEET, GATE, CBSE, UPSC).

## Overview
Notexia unifies AI study copilot tools, rich digital note-taking with block LaTeX and code syntax highlighting, curated semester and entrance exam revision notes, interactive formula calculators, and a gamified student creator economy. It empowers students to understand difficult concepts faster, prepare for high-stakes Indian examinations, publish verified study materials, and collaborate in peer study groups.

## Core Capabilities & AI Study Suite
- [AI Study Tools](https://notexia.in/ai-study-tools): Comprehensive AI learning suite featuring note generation, textbook summarization, formula extraction, and exam prep assistants.
- **AI Notes Generator**: Transforms raw syllabus topics, lecture transcripts, and textbook concepts into structured study notes formatted with headers, definitions, and key takeaways.
- **PDF Textbook & Document Summarizer**: Upload college textbooks, research papers, or syllabus PDFs to generate concise chapter summaries, key formula sheets, and concept checklists.
- **24/7 Step-by-Step Doubt Solver**: Resolves complex STEM questions in Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science with step-by-step solutions and copyable LaTeX math formulas.
- **AI Revision & Study Planner**: Generates personalized revision schedules, exam countdown timelines, and spaced repetition intervals for competitive exams and university semesters.
- **AI Flashcards Generator**: Automatically converts notes and textbook chapters into active-recall flashcard decks for quick review.
- **YouTube Lecture Summarizer**: Extracts timestamps, core concepts, and structured notes directly from educational YouTube lectures.
- **AI Presentation (PPT) Generator**: Auto-generates academic presentation outlines and slide decks for student projects and classroom seminars.

## Free Digital Study Notes & Exam Directories
- [Study Notes Hub](https://notexia.in/study-notes): Free library of community and educator-verified notes across Indian engineering curricula and national entrance exams.
- [Engineering & BTech Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/engineering): Semester notes, algorithms, operating systems, DBMS, computer networks, and core branch materials for BTech CSE, IT, ECE, ME, and Civil.
- [BTech Semester Guides](https://notexia.in/study-notes/btech): University exam revision guides, previous year question patterns, and subject blueprints.
- [JEE Main & Advanced Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/jee): High-yield Physics derivations, Organic Chemistry reaction mechanisms, and Mathematics shortcut formulas for IIT-JEE aspirants.
- [NEET-UG Revision Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/neet): NCERT line-by-line Biology revision summaries, Physics formula charts, and Physical/Inorganic Chemistry reference tables.
- [GATE Examination Notes](https://notexia.in/study-notes/gate): Short revision notes, engineering mathematics guides, and previous year solved problems for GATE Computer Science, Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, and Civil branches.
- [CBSE Board Material](https://notexia.in/study-notes/cbse): Class 10 and Class 12 board exam revision notes, NCERT exemplar solutions, and concept summaries for Science and Mathematics.

## Free Interactive Student Tools & Calculators
- [Free Tools Directory](https://notexia.in/tools): Collection of free calculators, formula sheets, and academic utilities for students.
- [Interactive Formula Sheets](https://notexia.in/tools/formula-sheets): Quick-reference LaTeX formula sheets covering Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics, and Computer Science for JEE, NEET, GATE, and BTech.
- [CGPA to Percentage Converter](https://notexia.in/tools/cgpa-converter): Official conversion formulas and calculators for CBSE Class 10 & 12, VTU, KTU, Mumbai University, Anna University, SPPU, and standard 10-point scale universities.

## Courses, Community & Creator Ecosystem
- [Verified Courses & Masterclasses](https://notexia.in/courses): Structured academic courses, programming bootcamps, and exam preparation tracks led by educators and top student creators.
- [Academic Blogs & Research](https://notexia.in/blogs): Articles, study strategies, exam analysis, and academic writing published by scholars and educators.
- [Student Q&A Forums](https://notexia.in/forums): Peer discussion forums for homework doubts, code debugging, and competitive exam strategies.
- [Peer Community](https://notexia.in/community): Collaborative study groups, batch channels, and academic networking.
- [Contributor Leaderboard](https://notexia.in/leaderboard): Gamified ranking system tracking community contributions, answered doubts, and published notes with reward programs and periodic tech giveaways for top scholars.
- **Coin Economy & Creator Monetization**: Transparent tokenized economy (1 INR = 10 Coins) where student authors and educators earn 70% revenue share on premium resources with direct UPI and bank account payouts.

## Technology Stack & Platform Architecture
- **Frontend Framework**: Next.js 15 (App Router), React 19, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Lucide Icons, GSAP animations.
- **Rich Text & Math Engine**: TipTap headless editor, KaTeX block and inline LaTeX formula rendering, syntax-highlighted code blocks.
- **Backend & Database**: Next.js Server Components, Route Handlers, MongoDB via Mongoose ODM.
- **Authentication**: Auth.js (NextAuth v5) supporting Credentials and Google OAuth.
- **AI Integrations**: Anthropic Claude (Claude 3.5 Sonnet) and Google Gemini models for deep reasoning and STEM problem-solving.
- **Payments**: Razorpay payment gateway integration for coins, course purchases, and subscription tiers.
